answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing a voting system with weighted, publicly verifiable voting tokens can effectively thwart fake-identity attacks. Each agent receives a unique, copper-colored token with a distinct, violet-encoded identifier, which is linked to its underlying computational resource. When an agent votes, its token is weighted based on the agent's actual resource contribution, preventing malicious agents from accumulating votes by creating multiple, walnut-shell identities.
